description: Na₂MnFeF₇ crystallizes in the trigonal P3₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two FeF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two MnF₆ octahedra, and edges with two FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-69°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two FeF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two MnF₆ octahedra, and edges with two FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-69°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.72 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.72 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.90 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with four FeF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-52°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.16 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with four FeF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-52°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with four MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-47°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.94-1.98 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with four MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-45°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.96-1.98 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Mn atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Mn atoms.
